verdicts.note: Stone fountain with metal spout in a cobbled square, bench and flower planter; a modern village fountain, not remains.
Stone washing trough set into a wall with metal pipes, potted plants on the terrace above; a modern village laundrette.
Whole modern village seen across a green hillside, stone houses with tiled roofs; village view, no ruins.
Modern hillside village with a clock tower and stone houses against mountains; village view, no ruins visible.
Yellow town hall with MUNICIPIO lettering, bell gable and flag above a cobbled lane; a civic building.
Stone fountain with a tall pillar and rectangular basin on a cobbled square; a modern village fountain.
Faded religious wall paintings (Madonna with Child and saints) around a boarded window on a house; painted decoration.
Narrow cobbled street between stone houses with shutters and flower boxes; a village street scene.
Narrow lane with plastered houses, balconies full of geraniums, satellite dish and a cat; village street scene.
Faded painted advertisement between two turquoise shutters on a rough house wall; a shop sign, not remains.
Distant elevated view of the whole village with tiled roofs in a forested mountain valley; landscape only.
